interpretation: The direct A-D result does not demonstrate an energized floating 53.5 V output under the unloaded test conditions, superseding the earlier untested possibility. Prior 12.3 V readings support the low-voltage contact groups; repeat E-B confirmation after the latest cycles is pending. The external high-voltage output, cable/contact path and model-specific enable/minimum-load behavior now need checking before attributing the failure solely to router detection. No exact supply identity, verified A/D net assignment, required enable signal or defective-brick diagnosis has been established.

interpretation_at_initial_readings: Reported values support B/C as the 12 V-side positive contacts and E/F as its return group, not necessarily protective earth. A/D are additional contacts on the PoE brick. A separate floating A-D output remains possible; fading A/D-to-E/F readings alone do not diagnose failed PoE output, establish an enable pin, or prove compatibility.
